pure-announcement.rationale: A first-person experience report, not a release note.

duplicate.rationale: No session-capture or proxy-logging concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The tool and its storage model are public; the recovery workflow is reproducible.

durability.rationale: The durable principle — capture conversation state at a proxy boundary you control, content-addressed, so recovery does not depend on the harness that crashed — is real, but the piece is a single-tool war story wrapped around it.

actionability.rationale: The workflow (run a recording proxy; on failure, point a fresh session at the recorded tree and resume) is directly reproducible with any equivalent logger.
